= reconcile v0 planted fixtures

These cases test the reconcile v0 checker in `src/interface/ffi/src/reconcile.zig`.
Run them with `tests/reconcile_fixtures.sh`.

Each case holds a `head.json` bundle (`reconcile-input/v0`), an optional `base.json` for the merge base, and the `expected.json` output (`findings/v0`).
The JSON files carry no SPDX header because JSON has no comments.
This file's licence covers them.

== Cases

[cols="1,3"]
|===
|Case |What it plants

|`dead-internal-link-pos`
|A missing sibling file, a link that climbs above the repo root, and a missing include. Expect three errors.

|`dead-internal-link-neg`
|Sibling, parent, root-absolute, directory, `./` and include links that all exist. Expect none.

|`dead-anchor-pos`
|A missing anchor in another doc, a missing local anchor, and one that differs only in letter case. Expect three errors. The case-only one is explained, never fixed (ADR 0002).

|`dead-anchor-neg`
|A heading id, an explicit anchor, a fragment-only link, a target doc outside the bundle (cannot be judged), and an empty fragment. Expect none.

|`missing-path-reference-pos`
|Two path mentions that are not in the repo. Expect two warnings.

|`missing-path-reference-neg`
|Present files and directories, `./` and `/` forms, a glob, placeholders, a command and an external URL. Expect none.

|`introduced-vs-base`
|A dead link that already existed at the base but moved ten lines, and a new dead link. Expect one finding with `introduced: false` and one with `introduced: true`.
|===
